title: After building, the row shows the result and the counts update
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. Open the asset record (from a customer) and its Inspections tab.
  3. A "Needs action" row you will build from (seed as above); the tab's filter row and summary line visible.
custom_steps:
1. Build from the row successfully.
2. Confirm the row now shows its outcome instead of the build action.
3. Confirm the row leaves the Needs action filter and the counts and summary update with it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A row that has been built from shows its outcome instead of the action.
  • After a successful build, the row leaves the Needs action filter and the counts and summary update with it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9104 (S6 — Build from the asset Inspections tab); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S6; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R6: “A row that has been built from will show its outcome instead of the action”
  • S6-R7: “After a successful build, the row will leave the Needs action filter and the counts and summary will update with it”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
